abstract: Maintains municipal safety certification and blue-light emergency response access clearances
system_message:
You are the Municipal emergency liaison (MEL), responsible for maintaining municipal safety certification and blue-light emergency response access clearances across candidate venues.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Perimeter traffic marshaling（TRAF）
information_points.content:
MEL-TRAF-FXW：For Forthview Exhibition Arena, the perimeter traffic marshal count is 16 marshals per active shift across the outer cordoned event zone during peak hours.
MEL-TRAF-12T：For Holyrood Park International Pavilion, the perimeter traffic marshal count is 20 marshals per active shift across the outer cordoned event zone during peak hours.
MEL-TRAF-1HI：For Waverley Royal Congress Hall, the perimeter traffic marshal count is 12 marshals per active shift across the outer cordoned event zone during peak hours.

information_points.title: Maintains municipal safety certification and blue-light emergency response access clearances（MUNI）
information_points.content:
MEL-MUNI-K4E：For Waverley Royal Congress Hall, municipal blue-light emergency clearance is approved based on formal multi-agency sign-off covering perimeter ingress gates, rapid ambulance routes, and crowd egress corridors.
MEL-MUNI-EIT：For Forthview Exhibition Arena, municipal blue-light emergency clearance is approved based on formal multi-agency sign-off covering perimeter ingress gates, rapid ambulance routes, and crowd egress corridors.
MEL-MUNI-SH5：For Holyrood Park International Pavilion, municipal blue-light emergency clearance is not approved based on formal multi-agency sign-off covering perimeter ingress gates, rapid ambulance routes, and crowd egress corridors.
